from pathlib import Path
import datetime,hashlib,json,subprocess,sys,time
out=Path('.cache/pr12-rc8/q4_native_audit/output')
name=sys.argv[1];argv=sys.argv[2:]
assert name.replace('_','').replace('-','').isalnum()
receipt_path=out/'execution_receipts'/f'{name}.json'
assert not receipt_path.exists()
receipt_path.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
started=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat();t=time.monotonic()
result=subprocess.run(argv,capture_output=True,timeout=60)
ended=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
paths={}
for stream in ('stdout','stderr'):
 data=getattr(result,stream);p=out/'execution_receipts'/f'{name}.{stream}.log'
 p.write_bytes(data);paths[stream]={'path':str(p),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'bytes':len(data)}
receipt={'argv':argv,'cwd':str(Path.cwd()),'started_at':started,'ended_at':ended,'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-t,'exit_code':result.returncode,**paths}
receipt_path.write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2))
print(result.stdout.decode(errors='replace'))
if result.stderr:print(result.stderr.decode(errors='replace'),file=sys.stderr)
sys.exit(result.returncode)
